admissionRule: H-CREDIT-RELATION receives prospective support only if both bound treatments outperform UNBOUND/NO_TRAIN without an opposing model-family effect. H-CREDIT-DISTANCE receives support only if NEAR_BOUND materially beats DELAYED_BOUND despite identical mappings.
authorityBoundary: Computing research only; no owner source mutation.
budget: Reuse the unchanged ACS fresh-Agent structured runner. Eight holdout cases x four treatments x two models x two replicas = 128 independent no-tool Harness trials. selectedOperation carries the three-class PAL capital prediction; identical Harness/output budgets apply to every treatment.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If bound examples do not improve held-out prediction, do not promote causal-credit binding from F3 retrospective evidence. If NEAR and DELAYED tie, narrow H-CREDIT away from temporal locality toward explicit relation/provenance binding.
evidenceSelection: Eight real Ordivon training change episodes with canonical later adaptive-capital labels and eight different real holdout changes with hidden canonical labels. Training and holdout rosters are frozen before live calls.
independentOracle: Canonical later Ordivon disposition/independent-consumption evidence used only by deterministic evaluator. Holdout labels are never Provider-visible.
invalidityConditions: holdout oracle leaks into Provider packet
training description/outcome label differs between bound treatments
UNBOUND label multiset differs from bound labels
treatment/label order changes after first call
invalid structured output scored as semantic miss
mission: Prospectively test whether transferable learning from prior adaptive episodes depends primarily on explicit change-to-outcome binding or on contextual/temporal proximity of feedback.
publicationBoundary: F9 may update Computing PAL hypotheses only; it does not authorize a global provenance graph, memory layer or feedback service.
questionOrHypothesis: When identical historical change descriptions and outcome labels are available, does preserving exact causal identity binding improve prediction of later adaptive value, and does adjacency add value once binding is preserved?
stopRule: Stop after 128 independent fresh-Agent trials terminate. Compare exact selectedOperation labels, class confusion, structured validity, model-family interaction and paired treatment deltas. Do not tune examples from model responses.
strongBaseline: NO_TRAIN plus UNBOUND. UNBOUND controls for outcome-label availability/count while removing causal relation identity; DELAYED_BOUND controls temporal distance while preserving exact identity.
treatments: NEAR_BOUND: each training change immediately followed by its outcome label
DELAYED_BOUND: all training changes first, then the same labels keyed by stable training IDs
UNBOUND: all training changes plus the exact same outcome-label multiset in a fixed shuffled order with the mapping withheld
